Solomon Northup, Twelve Years a Slave, edited by David Wilson.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/solomon-northup/twelve-years-a-slave

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Solomon Northup, the author, died 1864 (Wikidata Q3489578; death 1864 in the facts file).
- David Wilson, the editor and writer of the preface, died 1887 or 1870 (Wikidata Q15912423). The facts file gives 1887-01-01 and 1870-06-09; both are before 1925.

First publication of the text used: 1853 (SE colophon: 'Twelve Years a Slave was published in 1853 by Solomon Northup')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1853, before 1931, so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin (not needed for this decision): every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier (see the list above), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
